data.why: The app ships its own CC BY 4.0 fixtures (G02-G14, plus synthetic H1-H4 faults) selectable from a sidebar dropdown and loaded entirely from protorepair/fixtures.py with no network or system binaries needed; G02/G04/G14 are also plain-text files that can be handed to the file-uploader to exercise the local document-reader path without needing poppler/tesseract.

goals: Load a clean baseline NMC811||Li-metal coin-cell protocol and confirm it reads READY with no Critical/High/Medium findings
Load a protocol with a seeded loading/capacity mismatch (21 mg/cm² claimed as ~2.0 mAh/cm² at 200 mAh/g) and see the B2 finding, its severity, and the proposed local patch
Upload a plain-text protocol file instead of using the built-in selector and confirm the local reader extracts the same text and findings
Paste or edit protocol text directly (e.g. changing Li foil thickness or electrolyte volume) and re-run checks to see the readiness verdict change
Review the moisture budget tab to check per-component water contributions and the CAM-basis ppm / HF upper bound against the stated limits
Export the findings/patches/readiness as JSON or Markdown to keep for a pre-flight record before assembling the cell

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose exactly (pre-flight arithmetic and limit checks that give READY/REVIEW/NOT READY with one local patch per finding), and its phases, task labels and most cited screens hold up. It needs small fixes before filing: move t1, swap the t5 screen that shows P4's unknowns, record the upload-versus-example difference in t3, trim noise actions, and add an evidence-card feature and a missing-fields notice feature.
